name: Misham
overview: Misham was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Elpaal. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide additional information about his life or character. His mention situates him within the broader lineage of Benjaminite descendants.
namesAndTitles: The name Misham appears as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin indicated. Therefore, it is simply recognized as the personal name of this individual as recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:12.
familyAndRelationships: Misham is explicitly identified as the son of Elpaal. No other family relationships are recorded in Scripture for him beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Misham's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Benjamin. His mention in 1 Chronicles 8:12 contributes to the biblical account of the tribe's descendants, preserving the historical lineage important for understanding Israel's tribal heritage. Though not detailed further, his inclusion reflects the faithfulness of Scripture in documenting God's chosen people.
